text: I'm ever influenced by the countless greats Running from both their successes and their mistakes As well as those of my own Opportunities, whatever hurt is blown well These are the breaks, but Ask yourself if you never had the pleasure How all these other music lovers came to find its buried treasure Past the surface dwellers just wasn't ready for the depths of my sound That's why we call it underground But I propose these flows to be some of the illest survivors ever brought
